import math, json

def F(x):
    # antiderivative of ln(x-1)/(x-2)^2 : -ln(x-1)/(x-2) + ln|x-2| - ln(x-1)
    u = x - 2
    l = math.log1p(u)  # ln(x-1)
    return -l / u + math.log(abs(u)) - l

def num_check():
    # verify antiderivative by numeric derivative at a few points
    errs = []
    for x in [2.3, 2.7, 1.5, 2.9]:
        h = 1e-6
        d = (F(x + h) - F(x - h)) / (2 * h)
        f = math.log(x - 1) / (x - 2) ** 2
        errs.append(abs(d - f) / abs(f))
    return max(errs)

evidence = {"antiderivative_max_rel_err": num_check()}
